page.notes: Printing is irregular (broken letters in "pour", "Passaire", "desConstan-tin", "N'avès'veu"); readings marked [?] are doubtful. Text is in French, not Latin, and is transcribed as printed. No marginal notes on this page. Running head printed in small capitals as "JOH. MORINUS".
